source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(1, w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)))
    left_w = sep
    frame = next(v for v in grid[0] if v != 0)
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left_w))]
    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    for top, bottom in zip(separators, separators[1:]):
        if bottom - top <= 1:
            continue
        lpat = [grid[r][1:left_w-1] for r in range(top+1, bottom)]
        holes = [[v == 0 for v in row] for row in lpat]
        right_pat = [grid[r][sep+1:w-1] for r in range(top+1, bottom)]
        colors = {v for row in right_pat for v in row if v != 0}
        for color in colors:
            shape = [[v == color for v in row] for row in right_pat]
            if shape == holes:
                for i, r in enumerate(range(top+1, bottom)):
                    for j, c in enumerate(range(1, left_w-1)):
                        if holes[i][j]:
                            out[r][c] = color
                break
    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(1, w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)))
    left_w = sep
    frame = next(v for v in grid[0] if v != 0)
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left_w))]
    panels = list(zip(separators, separators[1:]))
    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    candidates = []
    for top, bottom in panels:
        right_pat = [grid[r][sep+1:w-1] for r in range(top+1, bottom)]
        for color in {v for row in right_pat for v in row if v != 0}:
            shape = [[v == color for v in row] for row in right_pat]
            candidates.append((shape, color))
    for top, bottom in panels:
        lpat = [grid[r][1:left_w-1] for r in range(top+1, bottom)]
        holes = [[v == 0 for v in row] for row in lpat]
        for shape, color in candidates:
            if shape == holes:
                for i, r in enumerate(range(top+1, bottom)):
                    for j, c in enumerate(range(1, left_w-1)):
                        if holes[i][j]:
                            out[r][c] = color
                break
    return out
'''
